subject: Request: training & vetting logs + redacted deprovisioning sample
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <security@starlight-health.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding & offboarding proofpack — SOC 2/CAIQ

Hi Priyom,

We're running through our vendor assessment for SOC 2 / CAIQ and need a short package showing Redwood's personnel onboarding/offboarding controls and training coverage. Specifically we need:  
- A redacted sample of background checks for 2 types of roles (engineer, support)  
- A Q3 training completion summary (security awareness, data handling) with percentages and timestamps  
- Deprovisioning logs showing SSO disables + account termination events for voluntary and involuntary leavers (sample CSV is fine)  
- Any attestation or playbook for offboarding timelines (SLA for access removal)

Can you provide a redacted bundle and a brief note on how PII is handled for these artifacts? We have a quick deadline — would appreciate anything by EOD Wednesday Pacific.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Security Engineer, Starlight Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <security@starlight-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & offboarding proofpack — SOC 2/CAIQ

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a compliance bundle that meets those items. A few quick Qs to make sure we deliver exactly what you need:
1) For the redacted background checks, do you want a 1:1 correspondence (one engineer sample, one support sample) or a 3-sample set per role?
2) For the deprovisioning CSV, is there a preferred column set (we usually provide: username, employee_id (redacted), event_type, event_timestamp, source_system).
3) We'll remove PII (names, DOBs) and replace with role and internal id tokens; confirm if that redaction approach is OK.

We can aim to have an initial package by EOD Wed PT. I'll coordinate with HR and SecurityOps and include a brief attestation of redaction steps.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: onboarding & offboarding proofpack — SOC 2/CAIQ

Team — forwarding Alyssa's request (Starlight). Need the following by EOD Wed PT so we can return the bundle: 
- Marissa: please pull two redacted background-check PDFs (one backend engineer hire, one support hire). Replace full name and DOB with "ROLE-ENG-XXXX" / "ROLE-SUP-XXXX" tokens. Keep vendor stamp and verification date. Zip the two files.
- Jonas: export a sample deprovisioning CSV for July-Aug 2026 with columns: username, internal_user_id (hashed), event_type (sso_disable, account_deleted), event_timestamp, initiated_by. Remove email addresses.
- Neha: export training completion report (Q3 2026) that includes course name, user_role, completion_timestamp, completion_status. Aggregate counts by role (engineer, support, sales).

Notes: add a short attestation paragraph describing redaction process, storage location, and retention policy for background artifacts. If anyone needs more time, call out ASAP.

Thanks — Priyom

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <security@starlight-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & offboarding proofpack — SOC 2/CAIQ

Hi Alyssa — attaching the requested bundle. See summary below and notes on redaction. Let me know if you want additional samples.

Attachment stubs: 
- redacted-bg-sample.zip (2 PDFs: ROLE-ENG-001-bg.pdf, ROLE-SUP-002-bg.pdf)
- training-completion-summary-2026Q3.pdf (aggregate + per-role exports)
- deprovision-log-sample.csv (sample of 25 events)

Summary: 
- Background checks: Provided two redacted checks (engineer, support). We replaced names/DOBs with role tokens and retained verification stamps and completion dates. No PII left in documents.
- Training: Q3 2026 security training completion: Engineers 96%, Support 88%, Sales 93%. Timestamps are included in the enclosed per-role CSVs.
- Deprovisioning: Sample CSV shows event types (sso_disable, account_deleted) with timestamps and hashed internal IDs. Median time-to-disable after termination event in the sample = 12 minutes; 95th percentile = 2 hours.

Redaction & handling note (attestation): 
Redaction performed by HR Security Operations. PII (names, DOBs, SSNs) removed and replaced with internal token IDs. Originals remain in HR's encrypted evidence store (KMS + HSM-wrapped keys) with access limited to HR and SecurityOps; retention follows contractual policy (7 years for verification evidence). On request, we can provide a scripted redaction log (hash mapping) under NDA.

Related links: Drive folder with exports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample/Prv-OnboardEvidence 
HubSpot record: HS-472109

If this looks good I'm happy to sign a short attestation PDF; otherwise, tell me what else you need.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted-bg-sample.zip (zip), training-completion-summary-2026Q3.pdf (pdf), deprovision-log-sample.csv (csv)

From: Alyssa Chen <security@starlight-health.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding & offboarding proofpack — SOC 2/CAIQ

Thanks — received and reviewed. The redactions look appropriate and the deprovisioning sample is helpful. We may follow up with one more sample showing an involuntary termination flow, but this is great for now.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alyssa
